# Júpiter Product Design Flow 1.1.2

Version 1.1.2 hardens carousel export and makes the repository reproducible across supported development environments.

Highlights:

- page-authored JavaScript disabled before navigation, with trusted controller evaluation for static slide export;
- HTTP and WebSocket blocking as defense in depth, plus real-browser zero-egress tests for HTTP, WebSocket and WebRTC/STUN;
- symlink-aware output confinement and isolated temporary files;
- exact Pillow and Playwright versions with an npm lockfile;
- Python 3.11/3.12 coverage on macOS and Ubuntu;
- an end-to-end Chromium export smoke test;
- companion-skill names aligned with the active Júpiter stack.

Compatibility boundary: the exporter no longer executes JavaScript supplied by the carousel page. Dynamic charts, DOM generation and other scripted content must be materialized as local HTML/CSS before export. The trusted controller still applies `body.export`, selects the requested `data-slide`, and waits for fonts and images.

Run the complete verification flow after installing the pinned dependencies:

```bash
python3 -m pip install --requirement requirements.txt
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
npm test
```
